subject: planner: Optimized EXTRACT(<UNIT> FROM <partition_column>) for partition pruning. (#54209)
summary: Reviewed the diff vs parent focusing on `pkg/planner/core/rule_partition_processor.go`: range partition pruning now recognizes `EXTRACT(unit FROM col)` (column is arg1, incl. CastTimeAsDuration) and enables inequality pruning only for monotone-safe units/types (YEAR/YEAR_MONTH on DATE/DATETIME; HOUR* on TIME/Duration via non-strict monotonicity with op relaxation). For other EXTRACT units it stays conservative (EQ-only pruning) and TIMESTAMP/timezone-dependent partitioning is expected to be rejected at DDL (covered by added casetests). No plausible correctness/semantics/data-consistency Blocker/High issues found in the planner changes.
